**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 26 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21 [Mivanian Soldier](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2546) **Source** [Pathfinder #190: The Choosing](/Sources.aspx?ID=198) pg. 27 **Perception** +17; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=23) **Languages** [Abyssal](/Languages.aspx?ID=12), [Razatlani](/Languages.aspx?ID=107), [Tengu](/Languages.aspx?ID=47) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +17, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +18, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +15, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +17, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +15 **Str** +4 **Dex** +3 **Con** +4 **Int** -1 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +1 **Items** [leather armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=4) bearing Mivanian insignia, [Manacles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=32), [_spike launcher_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1171) (20 spikes; Pathfinder Guns & Gears 156), _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [rapier](/Weapons.aspx?ID=36)_ --- **AC** 27 **Fort** +17 **Ref** +15 **Will** +13 **HP** 140 **Snap Shot** **Requirements** The Mivanian soldier holds a loaded [_spike launcher_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1171); **Trigger** A creature within 30 feet of the Mivanian soldier uses a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=114) action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using; **Effect** The Mivanian soldier attempts a _spike launcher_ Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't contribute to his multiple attack penalty, and his multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** _rapier_ +19 ([deadly d8](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Disarm](/Traits.aspx?ID=175), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)), **Damage** 2d6+10 slashing **Melee** beak +18 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)), **Damage** 2d10+10 piercing **Ranged** _spike launcher_ +18 ([Backstabber](/Traits.aspx?ID=172), [fatal d12](/Traits.aspx?ID=178), [Kickback](/Traits.aspx?ID=409), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range increment 120 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 1](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)), **Damage** 2d8+7 piercing **Go for the Eyes** **Trigger** The Mivanian soldier critically hits with a beak Strike; **Effect** The Mivanian soldier attempts to peck out his victim's eyes. The target must attempt a DC 26 Fortitude save.
**Success** The target is unaffected.
**Failure** The target is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1) for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** The target is blinded until healed to its maximum Hit Points. **Quick Spiker** The Mivanian soldier requires only 1 action, rather than 2 actions, to reload a [_spike launcher_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1171). He can change his grip on a spike launcher easily, improving its [fatal aim d12](/Traits.aspx?ID=404) trait to [fatal d12](/Traits.aspx?ID=178). (These changes are incorporated into its ranged Strike, above.
